'''Stomp Claw''' was a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] roaming the [[Glacial Fissure]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] circa [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stomp Claw is a rare champion spawn added to Hoth with the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion. He appears in the area that serves as one of the [[Seeker Droid]] dig sites and is not involved in any quests, Stomp Claw shares the character model with two other Sithspawn in the game, [[Gharj]] and [[Akure]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
